title: Koszul augmentation is an isomorphism on principal-open union
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, r a natural number, f : Fin r → A, and e ≥ 1. Write X = Spec A [def-pc-scheme], I for the deleted, shifted Koszul complex on the powers f(i)^e [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex, def-pc-shifted-koszul-augmentation]. The canonical augmentation I → A [def-pc-shifted-koszul-augmentation], after termwise associated sheaves and derived localization, restricts to an isomorphism on U = ⋃ᵢ D(f(i)).

source.place: Tag 08CX (perfect-section-koszul), definition of $I^\bullet$ and the assertion that $I_e\to\mathcal O_X$ becomes an isomorphism on $U$

proof.text: Fix i. Over D(f_i)=Spec(A_{f_i}) the complexes are the localizations at f_i, and f_i^e is a unit of A_{f_i}. Write D for the Koszul differential on the exterior algebra of E=A_{f_i}^{\oplus r} with \varphi(e_j)=f_j^e [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex], and let h be exterior (left) multiplication by f_i^{-e}e_i, which raises the chain degree by one. The defining formula D(v\wedge x)=\varphi(v)x-v\wedge D(x) with v=e_i gives D(e_i\wedge x)+e_i\wedge D(x)=f_i^e x, so Dh+hD=\mathrm{id} (Stacks, More on Algebra, Lemmas 0626 and 0663: multiplication by f_i^e is homotopic to zero). Hence the localized Koszul complex K^\bullet(f_1^e,\ldots,f_r^e)_{f_i} is contractible, in particular acyclic. Since this complex is the cone of the augmentation I^\bullet\to A (the Koszul triangle), the augmentation u_e restricts to a quasi-isomorphism on D(f_i).

source.place: Lemmas 0626 (lemma-homotopy-koszul-abstract) and 0663 (lemma-homotopy-koszul); perfect.tex Tag 08CX for the triangle

proof.text: The opens D(f_i) cover U by definition. Since the restriction of u_e is a quasi-isomorphism on every member of this cover, it is an isomorphism in D(\mathcal O_U). For r=0 the cover is empty and the assertion is vacuous; for r=1 the contracting homotopy is the usual two-term homotopy for multiplication by the unit f_1^e.

theorem affine_perfect_koszul_principal_unit_iso
    (A : Type a) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A) (e : ℕ) (he : 1 ≤ e)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{b}
      (SheafOfModules.{a} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{b}
        (SheafOfModules.{a} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over U))] :
    IsIso (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)
        (⨆ i : Fin r, (Spec (.of A)).basicOpen
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv (f i)))).mapDerivedCategory).map
            (affineKoszulAugmentation A r (fun i ↦ f i ^ e)))
